name: mixedModel2Fit
title: Fit Mixed Linear Model with 2 Error Components (matrix interface)

origin.description: Fits a mixed linear model by REML from response and design matrices.
origin.usage: mixedModel2Fit(y, X, Z, w=NULL, only.varcomp=FALSE, tol=1e-6, maxit=50, trace=FALSE)
origin.details: Matrix interface to the two-component REML fit used by mixedModel2.
origin.value: List with variance components, standard errors, and fixed coefficients.
origin.example: mixedModel2Fit(y, X, Z) on the petrol data matrices.

translation.description: Fits a mixed linear model by REML from response and design matrices.
translation.usage: mixed_model2_fit(y, x, z, w=None, only_varcomp=False, tol=1e-6, maxit=50, trace=False)
translation.details: Matrix interface to the two-component REML fit used by mixed_model2.
translation.value: Dict with variance components, standard errors, and fixed coefficients.
translation.example: mixed_model2_fit(y, x, z) on the petrol data matrices.
